page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a decorative woodcut headband at the top; a signature mark "¶, ij." at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: VERBVM Domini manet in æternum. Iesr. 40.8. 1.Pet. 1. 25.
main_text.p: NVLLA Prophetia Scripturæ propriæ explicationis est. Non enim libidine hominis allata est olim Prophetia, sed actià Spiritu sancto, loquuti sunt sancti Dei homines. 2. Pet.1.21.

TOTA Scriptura diuinitus (est) inspirata, & vtilis ad doctrinam, ad redargutionem, ad correctionem, ad institutionem, quæ est in iustitia. Vt perfectus sit homo Dei ad omne opus bonum perfectè instructus. 2, Tim. 3.16.17.
IMPIO dixit Deus: Vt quid tu enarras statuta mea, & assumis Testamentū meum super os tuum? Et tu odisti disciplinam, & proiecisti verba mea post te. Psalm.50.16. 17.

page.notes: Woodcut headband at top is decoration. Printed signature "¶, ij." at lower right. Old-style spellings kept as printed (e.g. "Scripturæ", "Testamentū"). Some ink fading and a water stain at the lower right edge; no text lost. Section rules between paragraphs are typographic dividers, not transcribed.
